title: Evidence for a sign change of the ISW effect in the very recent universe? Hot voids and cold overdensities at z<0.03
efc_relevance: Candidate local (z<0.03) ISW sign reversal: CMB temperature excess in the direction of nearby voids, and earlier cooling in filaments. The reported sign is the sign EFC's planned void-ISW sign-flip prediction requires for deep voids (DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.31942677), whose pipeline (DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.31990212) predicts a depth turnover near delta ~ -0.8 and amplification at R_v > 100 h^-1 Mpc. This paper bins by void size and radius, not by that depth coordinate, and its amplitude is an order of magnitude above the predicted Rees-Sciama and ISW terms. The authors' own interpretation is an unknown process, possibly non-standard dark energy - not EFC.
ledger_action: Recorded in the Atlas external-evidence register (docs/validation-ledger/data/atlas_external_evidence.json, FRAG-ISW-SIGNFLIP) as candidate compatibility only. No new Validation Ledger row: the EFC void-ISW P1-P3 remain planned predictions with no data confrontation, and this paper is not a test of them.
